scope: Phase 0.5 fixture completeness for refresh-node27-window-admission children 1-2; not a code-review round
summary: The four fixtures correctly split two independently ordered children, keep f24 lineage, freeze deployment 415cbd1e vs tool-delivery f24c3fb37, and keep parent T0/unstage/#2280 off the child gate. They must be revised: D12 is specified as deleting 000059, which inverts the frozen recover contract; the isolated window oracle cannot currently reproduce the seven ledger-only rows at both admission sites; Child 2 verification still points at a same-NEW smoke that cannot prove old-state/new-active handoff; and tools/ under this OpenSpec change have no CI-scope or archive-launch contract.

invariant_matrix_assessment.governing_invariant: Admit only the explicitly frozen, recoverable operation; preserve historical data and ownership before any operational mutation. (design.md:76)
what_is_adequate: Nine boundary rows cover prepare vs worker, target/import identity, old-pin/new-active, interrupted unstage, live audit criticals, and child-vs-parent readiness.
Child-readiness row correctly forbids claiming T0, production migration, live pin removal, or #2280.
blocking_defects: design.md:82 expand -> D12 says rollback removes only this operation's migration entry. Frozen recover does not delete schema_migrations rows: window_execute.py:1305-1308 is rename-only; :1280-1281 allows ledger_before or ledger_before+[EXPAND]; :1346 requires ledger == recovery_ledger; I8-1987.md:86-87 and :118-121 require the 000059 row to remain so ordinary migrate skips. The matrix would make Child 1 implement ledger deletion and enable re-expand.
D1 design.md:35, tasks.md:14, and spec.md:12 say D12 restores the complete original (pre-expand) ledger. That is the same inverted contract, not an independent row.

High-intensity template surfaces are missing as named inventory (source-of-truth, producers, validators, storage, entrypoints, downstream, failure, evidence). More important than labels: there is no regression row for disposable ledger = current files + seven named ledger-only versions, pending == [000059], at BOTH prepare and worker; and no row that after expand+D12 the ledger is original+000059 including the seven historical names.
required_matrix_rows: historical ledger x prepare: seven named ledger-only versions present, no retired SQL files, pending == [000059] accepted; ledger rows untouched.
historical ledger x migration worker: same input; zero pending and extra current pending refuse before apply.
D12: ledger still original + 000059 (000059 retained); historical seven retained; only rename reverse; retained narrow provenance kept.

unstage ordering: active==new target and ownership/drift checks, stop timer, remove owned pin, audit ordinary new runtime with no criticals, then restore original timer activity. HEAD still OLD refuses and keeps the 1a32 pin.

missing_axes.gap: Fixture currently requires D12 to restore the pre-expand ledger / remove the 000059 schema_migrations row. Frozen D12 is catalog reverse only and MUST retain 000059 plus all historical rows, including the seven retired names. Child 1 must not add ledger DELETE.

missing_axes.axis: historical ledger semantics at BOTH prepare and migration worker; verification executable under existing node-27 oracle conventions
missing_axes.gap: Evidence floor requires the seven observed ledger-only entries and a f24-red/child-green on the existing window oracle at both prepare and worker. The current oracle seeds apply_migrations_from_zero(through='000058') and therefore never has those seven rows; f24's subset check would stay green. Happy also drives worker('migrate') but does not execute Executor.prepare()'s PENDING_MIGRATIONS_NOT_EXACT against that history (prepare is production-gated; late-prepare/entrypoint paths do not seed retired versions). Name the seven versions, require INSERT into public.schema_migrations without recreating SQL files, and require both admission sites to see that catalog.

missing_axes.axis: Child 2 old-state/new-active compatibility and actual unstage audit ordering
missing_axes.gap: Handoff, interrupted unstage, live-runner, and pre-cutover refusal are required, but verification says run the existing published governance smoke. That smoke stages and unstages with one NEW constant after an in-process cutover flag; it does not consume 1a32-produced state with a 415cbd1e tool, does not refuse HEAD==OLD, and has no RUNNER_NOT_IDLE or interrupted-unstage resume. Discriminating Child 2 proof must be named: old tool at 1a32 writes state.identity/pin_digest; retargeted tool with identical args (operation excluded) unstages only after active==415cbd1e; audit of unpinned new runtime then timer restore; production unstage remains parent #1987.

missing_axes.axis: CI-scope and archive-launch for tools under openspec
missing_axes.gap: Executable owner is this change's tools/*.py. CI backend filter **/*.py will start the PR unit job, but openspec/ is not a backend prefix, so selection is collect-only; pytest testpaths=['tests'] will not collect these files; there is no CI ruff job. Archive would relocate the execution owner. Document: no tests/ mirrors; targeted local ruff + node-27 oracles are the evidence; do not archive this change before parent #1987 window (same discipline as I8 'Do not archive the shared change'), or name the post-archive stable owner path.

Child 2 requires the exact 168-point digest but does not pin it. Pin points=168 and response_sha256=84a95266f402a20d9f26834bba5f16972266f1075e6859798eea37b82738b483 against the retained isolated fixture; do not rerun write-budget 512232 as new evidence.

required_additions: Rewrite D1, the expand->D12 matrix row, tasks.md Child 1 D12 bullet, and spec scenario so D12 retains 000059 and the seven historical ledger-only versions; rollback is rename/provenance only; ordinary migrate must still skip 000059.

Add an isolated-oracle seed+assertion contract for the seven named versions (000007_flood.sql, 000015_flood_return_period_identity_indexes.sql, 000017_return_period_max_over_window_identity.sql, 000020_valid_time_discovery_indexes.sql, 000031_search_discovery_return_period_performance.sql, 000034_return_period_run_quality_materialization.sql, 000036_run_product_quality_explicit_source.sql) at both prepare and worker, using the existing guarded window_smoke launcher (private I8_REHEARSAL_DSN, parent-provisioned nwm-i8-1987-* disposable container, --oracle .../rehearse_river_rollback.py.txt, fresh DB/state per case). Keep the eight recovery cases and fourteen CLI cases as retained, not redesigned.
Name a Child 2 governance-smoke/handoff case that is not the inherited same-NEW happy path; keep production unstage off this change.
Pin the existing 168-point selector digest in Child 2 evidence.
Correct the invariant-matrix D12 row and add the discriminating historical-ledger and unstage-ordering rows listed above.
non_gaps: Risk packs: all 11 core packs are marked; Resource limits/discovery is not selected with a defensible preserve-existing-bounds reason; domain packs match project-profile.md. Selected packs map to retained oracles or explicit non-goals. Do not require a new File-IO symlink matrix or re-select hydro-met/Slurm/CRS/SHUD.
Child 1 independently mergeable: D2/tasks 1.1 keep old runtime pins and exclude governance retarget; not folded into Child 2.

Frozen deployment vs tool delivery: 415cbd1e vs f24c3fb37 receipts/hashes in design.md, proposal.md, and receipts/f24-baseline.json; OLD a8db554d and governance runtime 1a32ebb7 retained; absence on target is not retirement.

Child vs parent receipts: tasks.md section 3 and spec child-qualification requirement correctly keep T0, production 000059, owned unstage, #2280, and task 5.2 on parent #1987. No node-22 work and no production unstage before the window.
Unstage ordering in D3 matches governance_stage.py:657-687 (ownership/drift, stop timer, remove owned pin, audit unpinned active==NEW, restore timer). The gap is oracle naming, not the stated order.
Do not treat inherited window_smoke bulk (14 CLI, 8 recovery, late-prepare, write-budget) as newly designed behavior; only the historical-ledger seed and Child 2 retarget/handoff are new contracts.

Source ownership/provenance: adopt four f24 artifacts into this change's tools/, record original SHA-256 plus semantic delta, leave historical receipts untouched, skip the already-applied PGDATA patch.
